blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Rank counts only communities with at least ten homes listed. Falling listings with steady sales mean homes are being absorbed faster; rising listings with steady sales mean more choice for buyers. A sellers’ best bet is a community where homes sell quickly against the number listed; a buyers’ best bet is the reverse. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Between June 2026 and September 2026, detached houses: listings went from 28 to 27, and it took 4.2% of the city’s 215 sales over the period; condos and townhomes: listings went from 18 to 30, and it took 5.3% of the city’s 318 sales over the period.

The monthly write-ups singled out Poplar for detached houses in July, August, September (a buyers’ best bet); condos and townhomes in June (a sellers’ best bet); condos and townhomes in July, September (a buyers’ best bet).

faq.q: What zoning and suite rules apply to a Poplar house lot?
faq.a: Urban lots use RS zones in Zoning Bylaw 2400-2014, with RS3 at a 540 m² minimum interior lot and RS5 at 420 m² in City reports, and one secondary suite permitted in all single detached dwellings under s.140.3.8, with City-stated criteria including a 400 m² minimum lot size and 12.0 m minimum frontage.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Poplar than in June?
faq.a: Between June 2026 and September 2026, listings of houses fell from 28 to 27 and condos and townhomes rose from 18 to 30 in Poplar.

faq.q: How big is Poplar compared with the rest of Abbotsford?
faq.a: In September 2026, Poplar held 6.1% of the 440 houses listed in Abbotsford and 5.2% of the 572 condos and townhomes listed in Abbotsford.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Poplar from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 9 houses and 17 condos and townhomes sold in Poplar over those 4 months.
